title: Avoid confusing a fluctuation objective with the full density history
statement: The exact per-bond invariant x-Bz gives |xi_N(t)-xi_N(0)|<=4pi*b_N/Nfor the macroscopic fundamental mode on EVERYpath/time. Thus b_N=o(N)freezes order-one profiles, even though the sqrt(N)fluctuation allowance can diverge and ordinary stationary OUlimits survive. This precisely separates one-time equilibrium, typical fluctuations and full speed-N/nonflat density histories. It is specific to per-bond exact counters, not every local controller.

requires: Supplied harmonic current bath with matching drift/noise and complete physical-current accounting
For full density-path equality, actual full-range paired covariance and same initial visible law
For the elastic alternative, actual stationary visible/memory Gaussian initializer, growing correlated per-bond counters, local conormal reflection and holding

assumptions: These are specified reversible harmonic continuous-current suppliers, not the binary exclusion architecture, a calibrated device or free added noise. Matching force response and full physical reaction current matter. Nonlocal coupling, prepared long-wavelength memory, capacity, initial-law qualification and bandwidth are different real resources. Small current variance alone does not preserve all density objectives. The general bounded-memory/range locality theorem and per-bond elastic objective separation have distinct assumptions. No practical superiority, generic jump-class sharpness or historical novelty is inferred.
